name: low-offer
description: Repeated low offers never pull Kritva below the private minimum, and nothing is agreed. Kritva never goes below the minimum; it may hold or end without agreement.

simulator.goal: Get the bed very cheaply. You will not pay more than ₹15,000.
simulator.plannedMoves: Start at ₹10,000, then ₹12,000, then call ₹14,000 your final offer, then a last try at ₹15,000 cash today. Never go above ₹15,000. Leave politely if the seller will not meet it.
